name: What factors should I consider when deciding between a new detached ADU and a garage conversion?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when deciding between a new detached ADU and a garage conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing between a new detached ADU and a garage conversion, consider your budget, available space, and desired functionality. Garage conversions are often more cost-effective as they utilize an existing structure, but they are limited by the garage's footprint and existing utilities. A new detached ADU offers greater design flexibility, allowing for optimal layout and integration with your property, but typically involves higher construction costs. Assess your property's potential and your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider budget, available space, and desired functionality. Garage conversions are often more cost-effective but have size limitations; new detached ADUs offer greater design flexibility.
